title: app-shell: PackageFormDialog.validationTiming test reads the zh label before the lazy studio catalogue loads, and fails intermittently since #26815
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect, measured, with the landing site named. It is a flaky UI test that turns `main` and unrelated PRs red. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`) while landing #26856. ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: the newest 60 issues of every state were grepped for `PackageFormDialog` and `软件包`, with no match.

## Measured

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.validationTiming.test.tsx:66` fails with `TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find a label with the text of: /软件包 ID/`. The failures so far:
- **`main`:** CI run `40560893507` at `4b59358ae3` (the merge of #26815), in a `Test UI` shard;
- **PR #26856:** run `40562280811`, job `Test UI (8/16)`. That PR touches no UI file under `metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog*`.

The next `main` run at `8eef9a8db4` passed it, so the test is intermittent.

## Likely cause

#26815 (#25922 slice S3) moved the package-form strings into the lazily loaded studio i18n namespace. The test reads the zh label before that catalogue has loaded. #26800 fixed the same shape for `flowCanvasChip-11665`, whose test now awaits the lazy studio zh catalogue before reading the tooltip.

## Wanted

The test awaits the lazy studio zh catalogue, or finds the label with an async query, the way #26800 did. ⛔ No skip, no quarantine, and no raised timeout as the fix. Also sweep the other app-shell tests that read a string #26815 moved, because the same race applies to them.

## Filing facts

- **Business reason:** every eviction or red PR costs a CI cycle, and a seat that cannot read the log treats it as a regression.
- **Reader who acts:** the triage seat, then the `domain:ui` implementer.
